verses.text: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.”

lines.text: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet:
“Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You,

verses.text: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
People went out to him from all the Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
John wore clothing of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
And he began to preach, “After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
I baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove.
And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”
